title: merge-watch: surface poll failures (emit event after N consecutive null polls)
description: GhPollFn returns null on ANY gh error and stepMergeWatch silently retries forever: a sidecar with a stale/revoked GITHUB_TOKEN (401) spins mute (pollCount 40+) and never detects MERGED. Bit the CAM-163 ship twice: 2 manual sidecar respawns because the inherited env token was revoked (env var wins over .env; token rotation never propagates to a live sidecar). Fix: count consecutive null polls in merge-watch state; after threshold N emit a merge-watch-poll-error event and notifyOrchestrator once (not per-poll). Consider also logging gh stderr in the event detail for diagnosis.
